subjectTemplate: An IFPA administrator has made a change to your gallery
bodyTemplate:
Hi {memberName},

An IFPA administrator has changed {whatChanged} on your gallery {galleryName} on footbag.org. Your photos and videos were not removed and nothing you wrote about them has changed.

Administrator's note:
{note}

You can see the gallery by logging in to footbag.org and opening your galleries. If you believe this was done in error, submit a contact request from your profile edit page.

International Footbag Players Association
